localFindings.finding: merge accumulates fetched messages/notices without eviction; before/after/hasEarlier/complete currently describe the entire fetched range.
RoomSession cold sync already uses latest bootstrap and retains a bounded event window; do not rewrite its causal or ACK semantics to solve presentation history growth.
Non-focus refresh automatically syncs newer history. After tail eviction, blindly reusing this path would refill the evicted tail and displace the historical reading position.

Simultaneous first/last ID changes are handled as full-window swaps, unlike prepend anchor restoration. Opposite-edge eviction must preserve the live visible anchor; a persistent focus ID must not recenter on every window shift.
SettingsPage, AgentPage, TasksPage, SavedPanel, MemoryPage and DiscoveryPage still have static imports; official MainLayout already lazy-loads corresponding native panels.
DiscoveryPage is also a value import here; converting only ChannelApp import to lazy would not remove the static import path through TopBarSearch/context.

implementationOrder: Reuse native page/overlay Suspense fallbacks and dynamic imports; remove parallel static import edges; assert non-chat panels absent before navigation, then load successfully with desktop/mobile layout preserved.

Add bounded bidirectional RoomTimelineSession storage with explicit head/tail availability, distinguish historical reading from latest-following, maintain original stable identities and single cursor owner. Adapt native anchor preservation for trimming without replacing the entire timeline.
Measure fixed 50/5000/50000-message fixtures: first-page bytes and request count, retained items, DOM nodes, old/new round trips, memory plateau and resource requests. No paid models needed.
Consider generic virtualization only if bounded data and measured DOM cost still warrant it; do not import a second anchor manager preemptively.
requiredRegressionCases: Backward load evicts newest side and preserves the visible message/pixel offset
Forward load evicts oldest side with no duplicate IDs or skipped boundaries
New messages while reading old history do not yank the window to latest or refill discarded pages
Search/activity deep-link focuses exact message, subsequent scrolling does not repeatedly recenter
Image expansion, thread/inspector width changes and mobile keyboard preserve native anchoring
Window replacement invalidates stale async responses without acknowledging read/Inbox/Task
Long single messages require a byte/render budget as well as an item-count limit
verification: Read-only source review. No implementation, test acceptance, deployment, performance improvement or paid-run claim.
